rules.content:
/*
dragonransomware ransomware
*/

rule dragonransomware_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.dragonransomware"
        description = "Detects dragonransomware ransomware ransom note or artifact"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $name1 = "dragonransomware" ascii nocase
        $name2 = "DRAGONRANSOMWARE" ascii
        $onion  = "dragonransomware.onion" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
